interrupt_sources.trigger: Set when received data byte transferred into SPI Data Register. Cleared by reading SPISR (with SPIF=1) followed by a read of SPIDR.
Set when transmit data register is empty. Cleared by reading SPISR (with SPTEF=1) followed by a write to SPIDR.
Set when SS becomes LOW while master+MODFEN=1. Cleared by read of SPISR (with MODF set) followed by write to SPICR1.

interrupt_request: SPIF, MODF, SPTEF are logically OR'd into a single SPI interrupt request (subject to per-flag enables SPIE / SPTIE).
